description: Implement > independent review > regression tests > operator-gated integration
project_context: Development only. Preserve unrelated worktrees, all untracked evidence, and frozen architecture. Do not push, merge, delete, reset, clean, run security targets, or claim unverified work as proof. Read exact changed files and lines first.

steps.title: Small isolated implementation
steps.goal: Implement one specific reviewed change in the permitted files only. Close your output with ONE_HANDOFF_JSON describing results, tests, risks and next-focus locations.
steps.context: Replace placeholder commit and tailor objective to a known issue; do not perform unrelated refactors.

steps.title: Independent hostile diff review
steps.goal: Inspect predecessor worktree read-only at exact changed locations; challenge invariants, race/replay behavior, and failing edge cases. Provide P0/P1/P2 findings with file:line evidence.
steps.context: Review predecessor's uncommitted worktree; your own checkout is pinned and does not contain that patch.

steps.title: Targeted adversarial regression tests
steps.goal: Write tests for new behavior and review findings. Report fail-old/pass-new evidence where feasible.
steps.context: Do not assume source edits from implementer are present in your own worktree. Inspect predecessor receipts and worktrees explicitly.

steps.title: Prepare integration proposal
steps.goal: Synthesize code, tests and review evidence into a concise GO/NO-GO integration recommendation. Do not merge or push.
